reuse.why: Changes the existing getApproxAmountWorstCase/getRangedAmountWorstCase helpers, keeping getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule shrinks to one expression in each shared helper.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts where the worst-case definitions live and which getScheduledAmount and the budget schedule template both call.

scope.why: Only the two helpers, their comments, the tests and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Minimal, clearly documented change to the single source of the rule.
